speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *Eyes flare behind the bars. A green finger points.* You. The old ore lift. Is the chain still on the drum? Go. Look. Come back and say. I need it because the mine is mine.

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *The eyes tilt, almost pleased. A long finger beckons.* You again. The old miners' ore lift. Is the chain still on the drum? Look for me. Come back and say.
